verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a synchronous pre-recorded transcription endpoint (POST /v1/listen) and a Callback feature that pushes results to a supplied URL. Nothing documents creating a job with an ID, a status-polling endpoint, or named job states. The callback is a push-delivery mechanism that belongs to a different story and does not count as polling.

support.subject: As a developer, I create a transcription job and poll its status through documented job states until the result is ready
